name: create_role
description: Creates or updates a new agent personality or role, saving it as a JSON file in the 'roles/' folder. Enables the agent to self-adapt.

name.description: The lowercase identifier for the file (e.g. 'lawyer').

displayName.description: The name to display in the console, optionally with an emoji (e.g. '⚖️ Lawyer').

description.description: A short description of the role's purpose and skills.

systemPrompt.description: The detailed instructions and directives on the role's character and behavior.

allowedTools.description: The tools this role is authorized to use (e.g. ['read_file', 'web_search']).

global.description: If true, saves the role in the global TSUKA_HOME folder (accessible across all projects). If false or omitted, saves it in the local project (.tsuka/roles/).
